definitions.full: H2966. terephah טְרֵפָה noun feminine animal torn (by wild beasts); torn flesh ; — absolute ׳ט Gen 31:39 8 t. 1 animal torn (by wild beasts), of sheep and goats Gen 31:39 (E); ox, ass or sheep Exod 22:12 (J E; strike out We KlPr on Amos 3:12 , as gloss from Gen 31:39 ); indefinite 31:31 (J E; forbidden as food); commonly with נְבֵלָה (i.e. what dies naturally) as forbidden food, Lev 7:24 (P), 17:15 ; 22:8 (both H), Ezek 4:14 ; 44:31 ; torn flesh , in metaphor of Nineveh's king as lion Nahum 2:13 (|| ף טֶ֫רֶ ).

occurrences.englishText: That which was torn of animals, I didn’t bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.
But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.
You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.
The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.

“ ‘Every person that eats what dies of itself, or that which is torn by animals, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. Then he shall be clean.
He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am Yahweh.

Then I said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals. No abominable meat has come into my mouth!”
The priests shall not eat of anything that dies of itself, or is torn, whether it is bird or animal.

“Behold, I am against you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.”
